meanings.note: Manner or predicative adverb in '-о' derived from the corresponding adjective stem, used in everyday speech to mean 'fast'.

examples.trans: Quickly! Gather everything and get into my office.

meanings.note: Russian determiner/pronoun ('all') agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun phrase it specifies.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (root 'обрать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to collect', forming an aspectual pair with 'собирать'.

examples.text: Быстро! Собрали всё и ко мне в кабинет.

считать.gloss: to count; to think, to consider

meanings.en: to count; to think, to consider
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (root 'читать'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to count', forming an aspectual pair with 'посчитать'.

examples.text: Я тебя уволил! Открой дверь, я считаю до трёх.
examples.trans: You are fired! Open the door, I am counting to three.
You can't count.
I think you're right.

meanings.note: Russian preposition meaning 'until' that governs a specific oblique case on the following noun phrase.

examples.text: Я тебя уволил! Открой дверь, я считаю до трёх.

Goodbye!
